paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: Accuracy of Llama3.3 on PopQA with respect to s_pop and o_pop
model_annotation: The plot illustrates how accuracy varies as a function of popularity frequency, showing two accuracy curves with vertical error bars. The x-axis is labeled “s_pop frequency (x10^4)” and uses a linear scale ranging from 1 to 19, with tick marks shown every 2 units (1, 3, 5, …, 19). The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy” on a linear scale from 0.0 to 1.0, with evenly spaced ticks at 0.2 intervals. One line is a blue dashed line with circular markers and blue error bars; it starts near 0.70 at x=1, rises to about 0.92 at x=3 and about 0.96 at x=5, is around 0.95 at x=7, reaches about 1.00 at x=9 and remains about 1.00 at x=11, dips to about 0.90 at x=13, and then returns to about 1.00 at x=15, staying at about 1.00 at x=17 and x=19. The other line is a green solid line with square markers and green error bars; it begins around 0.36 at x=1, increases to about 0.45 at x=3, about 0.61 at x=5, and about 0.69 at x=7, drops to about 0.45 at x=9, rises to about 0.67 at x=11, decreases to about 0.60 at x=13 and about 0.50 at x=15, then increases to about 1.00 at x=17 and remains about 1.00 at x=19.
